intro: Today's headlines are dominated by the ripple effects of leadership changes at Nvidia and major shifts in AI tooling. Meanwhile, we are tracking significant developments in hardware innovation and industry-wide infrastructure challenges.

must_know.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
must_know.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its Dots AI agents to execute purchases for eligible US subscribers.
must_know.why_it_matters: The introduction of payment capabilities is a major step toward autonomous AI agents performing real-world commercial transactions.

must_know.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
must_know.summary: A timeline of the Jensen Huang scandal reveals his sudden resignation from Nvidia following an affair, raising questions about national security and corporate leadership stability.
must_know.why_it_matters: The sudden departure of a key figure in the global AI supply chain has significant implications for both tech markets and international policy.

must_know.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
must_know.summary: OpenAI has introduced Jalapeño, a custom inference chip designed for improved speed and energy efficiency. Additionally, new research indicates that the compute required to train neural networks has halved every 16 months since 2012.
must_know.why_it_matters: Advancements in both custom silicon and training efficiency are critical for scaling AI models while reducing operational costs.

big-tech.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
big-tech.summary: Amazon is reportedly developing a 'World Product Graph' to index global online shopping data, including products not sold on its own platform.
big-tech.why_it_matters: This move suggests an aggressive strategy to capture more consumer traffic by becoming the central source of truth for online commerce.

big-tech.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
big-tech.summary: Following Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, investors and founders anticipate a tightening of AI startup funding and a potential correction in valuations.
big-tech.why_it_matters: Nvidia has been a primary financier of the AI boom, and a leadership change could signal a broader cooling of speculative capital.

big-tech.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full-blown global cloud crisis
big-tech.summary: A major Microsoft outage affecting Outlook and Teams escalated into a broader global cloud services failure, with restoration currently underway.
big-tech.why_it_matters: The incident demonstrates the critical dependency of global enterprise infrastructure on centralized cloud providers.

tools.title: The future of the firm
tools.summary: AI is increasingly being integrated into corporate workflows and educational environments, with new tools for students and enterprise-wide software adoption. Companies like Omio and Sea Limited are leveraging these models to improve productivity.
tools.why_it_matters: The broad adoption of AI across various sectors signals a shift toward AI-native business models and automated operational workflows.

tools.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
tools.summary: LangChain has reached a $3 billion valuation, reporting 7,000 customers for its AI agent management platform, LangSmith.
tools.why_it_matters: The valuation reflects strong market confidence in the infrastructure layer required for managing complex AI agent workflows.

hardware.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
hardware.summary: Startup Drogue plans to power floating data centers using ocean thermal energy, with a prototype expected within two years.
hardware.why_it_matters: This represents an experimental approach to addressing the massive power requirements of future AI data centers.

hardware.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
hardware.summary: Research indicates that China's most advanced AI models have been trained using Nvidia chips subject to export bans.
hardware.why_it_matters: This highlights significant challenges in enforcing export controls meant to restrict China's access to top-tier AI hardware.

continuing.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
continuing.summary: The llama.cpp project has reached version 1.0.0, establishing a more stable foundation for the local AI ecosystem.
continuing.why_it_matters: Increased stability in local inference tools makes it easier for developers to run and optimize models on consumer hardware.
